hooks.statusMessage: Checking the commit rules of the tasker variant
Checking for commands that go around the commit gate
Writing the record of the result for the commit gate

hooks.command: sh -c 'ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"; F="$ROOT/.agents/skills/nossaifd/scripts/prose_gate.py"; [ -f "$F" ] || { exit 0; }; uv run --no-project --quiet --python ">=3.11" python "$F" start "$ROOT" || true'

sh -c 'ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"; F="$ROOT/.agents/skills/nossaifd/scripts/prose_gate.py"; [ -f "$F" ] || { echo {}; exit 0; }; uv run --no-project --quiet --python ">=3.11" python "$F" hook "$ROOT" || echo {}'
